meaning: Exhaustive three-way fork, with coverage only: the first horn overlaps each of the others (STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-CONTROLS). It adds no premise over a case split on well-foundedness and the coverage theorem, and its content is in that theorem. All three horns are witnessed in logical models, with non-well-foundedness witnessed both by a cycle and by an acyclic unending descent. No horn is asserted.
